word_family.gloss: 英语：骨；bones 的单数形式

senses.zh_definition: 英语 bone 的复数，意为骨头、骨骼；这里仅说明可确认的英语读法，不将其认定为正式马来语词。
senses.en_definition: The English plural of bone: the hard structures forming a vertebrate skeleton.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, bentuk jamak bagi bone, iaitu bahagian keras yang membentuk rangka manusia atau haiwan vertebrata; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah tulang.

collocations.ms: broken bones（英语；马来语：tulang yang patah）

messages.ms_spoken: Haah, tulang. Kalau nak ayam tanpa tulang, cari boneless.

etymology.historical_story: If this token is English, its history belongs to bone, which continues Old English bān and an older Germanic word. Bones adds the English plural ending. That history does not establish a Malay borrowing: without the original sentence, the supplied token could instead be a name or a data error. [Merriam-Webster: bone](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bone)
